quotes.text: 1a. ¿En la semana pasada, trabajó por lo menos una hora? (sin contar las tareas de su hogar)
... no podía trabajar por razones personales? (cuidado del hogar, estudios, incapacidad)
1. ¿Quién realiza la mayor parte de las tareas de la casa?

assessments.reasoning: Question 1a of the individual questionnaire explicitly excludes household tasks from work ('sin contar las tareas de su hogar'). Question 1e treats household care as a reason for not working ('cuidado del hogar'). In the household questionnaire, Block VII asks household-level questions about who performs most of the household tasks and who helps, rather than asking individual-level questions for each person. Thus, the instrument does not record domestic work for each person separately through individual questions.
